answer: A meadow tally starves fake identities: each real job cuts a timber tally, a client-signed count of verified work in a public yard. A bid above ten units needs a tally of ten jobs for three clients in a fortnight, checked by two peers with the clients within a day. A forged tally, one tally on two bids, or timber from one client burns a 27-unit bond; 100 fakes need 1,000 jobs and risk 2,700 units. Only tallies the inlet can trace get through.
